name: ts-band
description: Tailscale nodes' state in a band above the prompt, with a toast when a node comes up or goes down

tailscalePath.title: tailscale CLI
tailscalePath.description: Path to the tailscale CLI; empty looks on PATH, then Homebrew and the macOS app

intervalSeconds.title: Refresh interval (s)
intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of tailscale status (at least 10)

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Hosts to show, comma separated, in this order; host=label renames one; empty shows every node

hideOffline.title: Hide offline nodes
hideOffline.description: Leave offline nodes out of the band (they still count in the total)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, toasts and /ts; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
